// Phase 3G.2 - Prepare Access Upsert (includes reply profile fields)
const j = $input.first().json;
if (!j.access_registry_write || !j.access_upsert) {
  return [{ json: { ...j, sheets_access_mutate: false, sheets_event_mutate: false, profile_event_write: false } }];
}
const r = j.access_upsert;
const ev = j.access_event || {};
const pev = j.profile_event || {};
function flag(v) {
  if (v === true || v === 'true' || v === 1 || v === '1') return 'true';
  if (v === false || v === 'false' || v === 0 || v === '0') return 'false';
  return String(v ?? '');
}
return [{ json: {
  ...j,
  sheets_access_mutate: true,
  sheets_event_mutate: Boolean(j.access_event),
  profile_event_write: Boolean(j.profile_event),
  telegram_user_id: String(r.telegram_user_id || ''),
  telegram_user_hash: String(r.telegram_user_hash || ''),
  telegram_username: String(r.telegram_username || ''),
  display_name: String(r.display_name || ''),
  role: String(r.role || ''),
  status: String(r.status || ''),
  first_seen_at: String(r.first_seen_at || ''),
  last_seen_at: String(r.last_seen_at || ''),
  requested_at: String(r.requested_at || ''),
  approved_at: String(r.approved_at || ''),
  approved_by: String(r.approved_by || ''),
  revoked_at: String(r.revoked_at || ''),
  revoked_by: String(r.revoked_by || ''),
  source: String(r.source || ''),
  notes: String(r.notes || ''),
  reply_profile_number: String(r.reply_profile_number ?? ''),
  reply_sender_name: String(r.reply_sender_name || ''),
  reply_sender_enabled: flag(r.reply_sender_enabled),
  reply_company_name: String(r.reply_company_name || 'INTLSEO'),
  reply_profile_version: String(r.reply_profile_version || ''),
  reply_profile_updated_at: String(r.reply_profile_updated_at || ''),
  reply_profile_updated_by: String(r.reply_profile_updated_by || ''),
  ts: String(ev.ts || new Date().toISOString()),
  opaque_user_ref: String(ev.opaque_user_ref || ''),
  event: String(ev.event || ''),
  prior_role: String(ev.prior_role || ''),
  prior_status: String(ev.prior_status || ''),
  new_role: String(ev.new_role || ''),
  new_status: String(ev.new_status || ''),
  actor_ref: String(ev.actor_ref || ''),
  event_source: String(ev.source || ''),
  outcome: String(ev.outcome || ''),
  detail: String(ev.detail || ''),
  notify_kind: String(j.notify_kind || ''),
  pev_event_id: String(pev.event_id || ''),
  pev_profile_number: String(pev.profile_number ?? ''),
  pev_event_at: String(pev.event_at || ''),
  pev_action: String(pev.action || ''),
  pev_previous_name: String(pev.previous_name || ''),
  pev_new_name: String(pev.new_name || ''),
  pev_previous_enabled: flag(pev.previous_enabled),
  pev_new_enabled: flag(pev.new_enabled),
  pev_actor_ref_safe: String(pev.actor_ref_safe || ''),
  pev_actor_display: String(pev.actor_display || ''),
  pev_reason_source: String(pev.reason_source || ''),
  pev_profile_version: String(pev.profile_version || ''),
}}];
